implementation: Actual root-owned worker enters the RSC owner only after real captured CommandDB reader/binding success and explicit zorn26_rsc_layout_read selection.
Controller owner retains actual platform/root/code/parent/thread/provider/claimant and drv2 descriptor. It uses a real exclusive provider open and checked readonly noncached mapping.

Actual Linux-defined revision/config/solver,IRQ-enable/status and per-TCS status/control/command-enable reads are source-bounded. Native channel cells and actual revision determine layout/count;no values are synthesized.
Only terminal returned status is copied. No map address is exported,no IRQ is registered/unmasked,and no TCS register is written by this owner phase.
Original cold-controller,IRQ and full startup bodies remain;an idle-looking read or IOService open is not substituted as their grant.
limitations: No new phone/native/MMIO read occurred. Existing v17 CommandDB observation is not RSC hardware evidence.
Candidate inherits consumed v17 identity inputs and is not runnable;fresh exact identity/native capture/bundle/admission is required before any hardware test.
Controller programming,real CPU-cluster PM coordination and cold/start ownership remain to implement/integrate;this phase is not a completed RSC controller or GPU driver.
